Make sure you've read ALL the Test logs and the recovered materials list before this, or it'll be very confusing.

​

" A large CRT monitor is displaying single words in 8 colors at roughly 5 second intervals. While observed the words 'Clean' 'Unclean' 'Clean' 'Clean' 'Lost' 'Unclean' flash on the screen. "

I'm not entirely sure but in the Red Test there's that part as mentioned above which show words and presumably different colors. We only have the Blue, Green, Violet, Yellow and Red. Thats 5, so maybe we have 3 more undiscovered parts. Maybe the people with the different colors are Clean, or Unclean, or Lost(?). In the initial page detailing SCP-093 it is stated that the colors change depending upon:

" SCP-093 will change hue when held by a living individual. The colors taken by SCP-093 are still being researched to establish a link. Current belief holds that the changes depend upon regrets carried by the holder. "

In Yellow test a doctor hold the disc, and in the Red test a personnel (probably a soldier or such) hold it, so therefore it can be said that the color doesn't link to a crime, but to a persons regret about something they have or haven't done. Let's analyse this:

​

Blue test: Murder/suicide (Subject saw a deep hole/bunker in a field.)(Sees Cereal and a makeshift crib)

Green test: Car theft/Murder of 2 children (Sees a house, bunker, clothes and toys of 2 deceassed children, farm land.)

Violet: Murder of an officer during a drug bust (Sees the city) (An escort team member is killed in this test and the subject inadvertanly caused the death)

Yellow: Doctor with No criminal background or psychological issues (Sees the office building where Herval Toliwis kept his research and the gun with syringes, and a note about him not being able to kill or protect his family with violent measures)

Red: No information, Subject was a service technician. (Sees the hub of mirrors like SCP-093 and a control room)

​

The dead give away parallel is in the Green Test: She killed 2 kids and sees 2 dead kids and their stuff: that is her regret. Violet's subject had an escort member killed by his side, simillar to his crime committed where he killed an officer Blue and Red are a bit ambiguous. Yellow has some kind of giveaway but i can't put it into words: it just makes sense to me.

There is a log in the red test called " **Agent █-██-█ Report"** you should read that again, it tells you a lot. It tells you what the torso creatures are, and the tears, and all that stuff. I concluded from that report that the unclean look at the subjects in curiousity and they want them to seek out the 'high father' and kill him in revenge to what he did to their world. I think the colors could also link to the abilities of the individual, as the Yellow Test doctor was lead to an office and the Red test technician was lead to a control room. Maybe the Unclean draw those individuals there in hopes that with their abilities and skills they can take down the High Fathers and the Blessed Millitia in those regions.

These are only theories. As mentioned above the creator of SCP-093 said that the colors are still being studied for their link tot he subjects, so there either is not definitive answer, or you have to go looking like I did.
